responsibility: Implements the global reassociation pass for SSA GIMPLE arithmetic and logical expressions. It linearizes associative expression trees, ranks and reorders operands to expose redundancy, cancels inverse/repeated operands, optionally introduces __builtin_powi for repeated factors, rewrites expressions in profitable order, repropagates negates, and performs branch-oriented fixups so subsequent value numbering, math opts, and code generation can see simpler and more canonical expression forms.
same_name_distinction: Implements the reassociation pass algorithm: flattening associative trees, ranking and reordering operands, canceling terms, optionally introducing __builtin_powi, and performing branch fixups. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-reassoc.h, it is the full pass implementation rather than the small support header defining shared data structures and utility declarations.
